description: Scrape TikTok's Explore/Trending feed. Choose specific category IDs or enable auto-discovery to find all available categories.

autoDiscoverCategories.description: When enabled, navigates to TikTok's Explore page and clicks each category tab to discover all available category IDs from the live UI. Discovered categories are added to the categories list.
autoDiscoverCategories.title: Auto-Discover Categories

categories.description: Category IDs to explore. The 'All' category (id=123) is always available. Use autoDiscoverCategories=true to find additional category IDs from the live TikTok UI.

id.description: Numeric TikTok category type ID (e.g. 123 for All)
id.title: Category ID

name.description: Human-readable category label (e.g. All, Entertainment, Sports)
name.title: Category Name

categories.title: Categories

categoryId.description: Shorthand: a single integer category ID. Maps to categories=[{id: N}]. Use 123 for All.
categoryId.title: Category ID (shorthand)

maxItems.description: Alias for maxItemsPerCategory. If both are set, maxItemsPerCategory takes precedence.
maxItems.title: Max Items (alias)

maxItemsPerCategory.description: Maximum number of trending posts to collect per category.
maxItemsPerCategory.title: Max Items Per Category

title: TikTok Explore/Trending Scraper Input
